items.b: RINGS.COM PUTS THE LAB-GROWN 1-CARAT MEDIAN BACK AT $571
items.t: The September edition read 251,098 listings at seven US retailers on 17 September. Ritani raised its one-carat asking median 26% to $281 while Brilliant Earth cut its 1.5-carat cell 32%.

items.b: GOLD OPENS THE WEEK $28.80 LOWER AT $4,348.20 AN OUNCE
items.t: Silver added half a cent to $66.132, platinum lost a dollar to $1,795.00 and palladium lost a dollar to $1,282.00. Gold's overnight range ran from $4,339.30 to $4,384.30.

items.b: RAPI'S 1-CARAT HOLDS AT $3,912.13 FOR A FIFTH MORNING
items.t: The index has posted no new point since 16 September, though it moved to daily publication on 7 September. IDEX's broad one-carat driver averaged $3,051.17, 22.0% below it.

items.b: DE BEERS AND SHANGHAI'S BOURSE MEET ON NATURAL-DIAMOND VALUE
items.t: The Natural Diamond Council and the Diamond Federation of Hong Kong convened the session on 17 September during Jewellery & Gem World. No figures were released.

items.b: DGCX HANDS ITS TRADING AND CLEARING ENGINE TO TCS
items.t: Tata Consultancy Services will supply BaNCS for central counterparty clearing and trading, and Quartz for surveillance and connectivity. TCS shares rose 5.19% to ₹2,315 on the National Stock Exchange on 15 September.
